Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.eloquent.relations

Class MorphOneOrMany<R extends Model,S extends MorphOneOrMany<R,S>>

java.lang.Object
org.aristonis.diwan.database.eloquent.relations.Relation<R,S>
org.aristonis.diwan.database.eloquent.relations.HasOneOrMany<R,S>
org.aristonis.diwan.database.eloquent.relations.MorphOneOrMany<R,S>
Type Parameters:
R - the related model class
S - the relation's own class
Direct Known Subclasses:
MorphMany, MorphOne
public abstract class MorphOneOrMany<R extends Model,S extends MorphOneOrMany<R,S>> extends HasOneOrMany<R,S>
A polymorphic has-one or has-many: the related rows hold the parent's key in an id column and the parent's morph class in a type column. Laravel's MorphOneOrMany, the common part of MorphOne and MorphMany.

Every lazy, eager and existence query adds related.type = ? with the parent's ModelMorphRelations.getMorphClass() bound. The morph class is read each time a query is built, not when the relation is created, so a change of the morph map in between is honored. Writes set both the id and the type. Single use, not safe to share across threads (see Relation).
